title: yadgar/seeder
$comment: Closure is per chart (ADR-0850): this schema closes the keys this chart owns, so a typo in a key name refuses at render. Types, ranges and every cross-key rule are `templates/render-checks.yaml`'s job (ADR-0797, ADR-0847), which names the key and the reason in a sentence, WITH ONE EXCEPTION: `project.requestTimeoutSeconds`, `sync.attempts` and `sync.backoffSeconds` carry their integer ranges here because the binary's own bounds are pinned against these numbers (`tests/chart.rs`). `registry` IS REQUIRED, WITH NO DEFAULT: this is the ADR-0857 CONTRACT step (v0.1.x was the expand step, where an absent block rendered nothing). The schema refuses an absent block in helm's own words; `templates/_registry.tpl` refuses a `registry: null` the schema lets through, and any render that skips the schema, in a sentence naming the key. A present block is closed here and checked whole by `templates/render-checks.yaml`. `global` is the open block the parent forwards to every module.
